idea-plugin.name: Branch Commit Message
idea-plugin.description:
Prefills the commit message with the current Git branch name.
The message is formatted as a Git subject followed by an empty line, and the caret is placed on the line after that empty line, ready for the commit body.
  • Works in the Commit tool window and in the classic commit dialog.
  • Updates the message when the current Git branch changes, as long as the user has not started editing the message.
  • Does nothing in detached HEAD state.
